en: A vibrant town square scene with a market and various vintage cars parked around an open plaza. People are seen walking, cycling, and shopping at outdoor market stalls. Surrounding the square are two- and three-story mid-century buildings, including a hotel or café on the right with the word 'Kapphandel' visible and a bakery or restaurant at street level. The town is bordered by trees and low hills in the distance, under a clear blue sky.
